title: The 660-Tonne Ball That Keeps a Skyscraper Steady 🏙️ #shorts
description:
Near the top of Taipei 101 hangs a 660-tonne steel ball. It's a tuned mass damper: a giant pendulum tuned to the tower's own rhythm, so when the building leans one way the ball pulls the other, cutting the sway by up to 40%. In 2015, Typhoon Soudelor swung it a full meter.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
